A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Where is Data Foods located?

Our mill is located at 22-KM Ferozpur Road, Gajjumatta, Hudyara Drain, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan.

Do you work with businesses and distributors?

Yes. Data Foods serves individual consumers as well as corporate and government customers. Contact our team to discuss your business, required volumes and flour applications.

How can I find the right flour for my needs?

Tell our team what you make and the quantity you need. They can discuss available flour options, packaging and specifications with you.
